name: Li Zhuowu
motto: The finest writing under heaven has never failed to spring from the childlike mind.

name: Jin Shengtan
motto: The wonder of writing lies wholly in having no fixed method.

name: Lu Xun
motto: Gods and demons all have human feeling; spirits and monsters too know the ways of the world.

name: Hu Shi
motto: Journey to the West is a work of play.

name: Mao Zedong
motto: Today we hail the Great Sage Sun, for the demon mist has come again.

name: Lin Yutang
motto: Wukong is the embodiment of Chinese freedom.

name: Qian Zhongshu
motto: Journey to the West is a deep repository of what the Master did not speak of.

name: Guo Moruo
motto: Man and monster reversed, right and wrong confused; merciful to the enemy, harsh to friends.
